gold passage 'भेदविवक्षया कटकादिभिन्नस्याभेदविवक्षया कटकाद्यभिन्नस्य सुवर्णस्य कुण्डलादन्यत्वम्' muddled; the conclusion 'otherness from the earring' is lost

defects.detail: the opening lines, garbled 'ὥστε τὴν ᾗ δὴ ᾗ ἐξ ἀφθόνων γεγονός τε φαίνεται καὶ παιδευομένων…', are smoothed into quasi-sentences ('since it has come to be from an abundance, it appears both as being educated')
<summary> 'Proclus examines the Demiurge's use of analogy and geometric proportions' names an author and a thesis that the garbled page does not state

reason: the source is heavily garbled OCR (endless ᾗ); the translation is mostly a literal word-by-word rendering marking ᾗ as [insofar as], with some smoothing; the summary over-asserts. I read this garble weakly.
